memoryBuilder.verseText: He arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran.

sequence.prompt: What happened to the lost son? Put the story in order.

items.label: Son takes money and leaves home

matches.prompt: Match each to what they did.

pairs.right: Ran to his son and forgave him
Loves us and forgives us always

application.question: The father ran to meet his son! How does it feel to know that God loves you like that — no matter what?
application.followUp: God is like that father — He sees you from far away and runs toward you with love. You are always welcome home with God.
